system.description:
You begin to hum a tune of your choice that radiates illusory chakra that seeps into the psyche of creatures in range. Select the melody you wish you recite when this jutsu is cast, each coming with its own set of effects for this jutsu’s duration. You can switch the tune at the beginning of each of your turns by spending a Bonus Action.

For the duration, you do not spend chakra to maintain this jutsu, instead you must spend a bonus action on subsequent turns to maintain it. Switching tunes also maintains this jutsu.

Revitalized Tune. Willing allied creatures who begin their turns within range gain a rank of mastery on their next Saving throw before the beginning of your next turn.

Revealing Tune. Genjutsu that would affect a Willing allied creature in range with the Auditory and Unaware Keywords, lose the Unaware keyword when affecting creatures benefiting from this jutsu.

Restoring Tune. Willing allied creatures who begin their turn within range gain 1d6+4 temporary hit points, which last until the beginning of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher you can use the Courageous Tune. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you use the Survival Tune. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you can use the War Tune.

Courageous Tune. Willing allied creatures gain immunity to the Demoralized and Concussed conditions.

Survival Tune. Willing allied creatures gains the benefits of the Dash and Disengage actions.
